author: simulation_agent

targets.note: explore: which plane an observation depends on, how far a wrong plane moves the answer, and which plane a sharpness-maximum focus search finds, in decades (task 026)

constraint_notes: the person asked manager-simulation-20261007-1 on 2026-10-07, in that manager's window, to find what the simulation side can do and improve once dino-autofocus's focus search is in the workflow; the manager turned that into task 026 for this seat

once the microscope records the focal plane its focus search found, every comparison these predictions enter depends on a plane that is checkable; this question says which plane each observation depends on and how much a wrong one moves it
two samples: the 100 nm fluorescent beads of sim-20260930-401, and the 5 um beads of the double-well questions

no number from this question goes toward the instrument as a Z target, a range, a coverslip position or a limit. The per-lens focus limits are the person's and are written, not derived; what this question produces are predictions about the sample and the measurement
no image is rendered and no declared model changes: closed forms and exact deterministic integrals only. bd_overdamped has neither walls nor optics, and none is added

the observable named is the bleach recovery's, because item 1 and item 4 are about what the agreed bleach fit reads; items 2 and 3 are conditions of every observable on these samples and are reported beside it
the result crosses to the microscope only on the person's hand-over

assumptions.statement: The chamber is between 10 and 100 um deep. Nothing records it, and every item 1 and item 2 answer is given at 10, 30 and 100 um.
assumptions.falsifier: the chamber the microscope side uses replaces it

assumptions.statement: A bleach disc of 1 to 30 um radius, the span the earlier bleach result found workable.
assumptions.falsifier: the disc radius in the microscope plan replaces it

assumptions.statement: The patterning light fills the objective's aperture and is focused where the camera is. Both are the worst and simplest case; how the pattern reaches the sample is not recorded.
assumptions.falsifier: the projection path's description -- which lens, whether the pattern is conjugate to the camera, and the illumination aperture -- replaces it

assumptions.statement: A focus-search frame of about 10 ms. It sets how much a free bead blurs and so how many stuck beads outweigh it.
assumptions.falsifier: the focus search's exposure replaces it

kb_refs.claim: The laboratory's ambient temperature is 20 degrees Celsius, read off a thermometer by the operator; the room's, not the sample's.
Dynamic viscosity of pure water near 293 K is of order one millipascal second.
The density of air-saturated distilled water at 20.0 degC is 0.998201 g/cm^3.
Distilled water at 20 degrees Celsius has a refractive index of 1.3325138 at 605.0 nm.
Nikon CFI Plan Apo Lambda D 4X: dry, NA 0.20.
Nikon CFI Plan Apo Lambda D 10X: dry, NA 0.45.
Nikon CFI Plan Apo Lambda D 20X: dry, NA 0.80.
Nikon CFI Apo Lambda S 40XC WI: water immersion, NA 1.25.
Nikon CFI Plan Apo Lambda D 60X Oil: NA 1.42.
Nikon CFI Plan Apo Lambda D 100X Oil: NA 1.45.
The six nosepiece positions hold the 4x, 10x, 20x, 40x water, 60x oil and 100x oil objectives.
The 100 nm fluorescent beads on this bench are Invitrogen FluoSpheres F8801, by the person's statement.
Invitrogen F8801 microspheres are 0.1 um in diameter (nominal).
Invitrogen F8801 microspheres are excited at 580 nm.
Invitrogen F8801 microspheres emit at 605 nm.
Invitrogen F8801 microspheres are polystyrene, carboxylate-modified.
The particles in the bottle in use are 5 um in diameter, measured by the operator.
The AFR-0500-COOH product emits at 680 nm.
The AFR-0500-COOH particle material has a density of 1.03 g/cm3. Cited for the 100 nm beads on the assumption both are polystyrene.
Bulk polystyrene has a refractive index of 1.592 at 587.6 nm.
The expected translational diffusivity of a sphere in bulk fluid is the Stokes-Einstein value; used as the relation only.
Total depth of field is the wavelength times the medium's index over NA squared, plus the index times the detector's resolvable distance over magnification times NA.
With the 4x objective one pixel spans 1.625 um at the sample.
With the 10x objective one pixel spans 0.65 um at the sample.
With the 20x objective one pixel spans 0.32373 um at the sample.
With the 40x objective one pixel spans 0.1625 um at the sample.
With the 60x objective one pixel spans 0.10833 um at the sample.
With the 100x objective one pixel spans 0.065 um at the sample.
Each of dino-autofocus's classical focus metrics reaches its maximum over a z sweep at the plane of best focus. This question asks which plane that is for a given sample.
peak_brightness is the brightest spot of the block-binned frame minus its median, meant for sparse particle fields.
